newsitem.title: UK: Associations to agree market conventions for Euro.
newsitem.headline: Associations to agree market conventions for Euro.

text.p: Five international financial trade associations said on Thursday they would announce recommended market conventions on May 29 that will be used for transactions in euro after European Monetary Union.

"The associations believe that harmonised conventions will encourage transparency and therefore liquidity for the new euro markets, and secondly, will avoid confusion and disputes between market participants," they said in a statement issued in London.
"This will then allow the financial markets to start systems changes to prepare for EMU."
Market standards such as day counts, rate fixing periods and business holidays will be revealed.

The five groups, Association Cambiste International, International Paying Agents Association, International Primary Market Association, International Securities Markets Association and International Swaps and Derivatives Associaition, supported by Euroclear and CEDEL, will publish the recommended standards at a news confernce in London.
